description: Freshet Feeds on a small site: one feed on the bundled Mock provider, cached and rendered on the front page through the Feed block in its grid and list layouts, landing on that page.

options.blogdescription: Small-batch coffee, and a feed of what we are up to

steps.code:
set_permalink_structure('/%postname%/'); $wp_rewrite->flush_rules(false); $plugin = Plugin::instance(); $feeds = $plugin->feeds(); // One feed on the Mock provider. WP_ENVIRONMENT_TYPE is set to "local" by the // step before this one: the provider refuses to fetch on a production site, and // a Playground that does not say otherwise reports production. $feed = $feeds->findBySlug('roastery-news') ?? $feeds->save(new Feed( id: 0, name: 'Roastery news', slug: 'roastery-news', providerId: 'mock', settings: [], count: 6, ttl: HOUR_IN_SECONDS, defaultLayout: 'grid', )); // Warm the cache now, so the landing page serves items instead of fetching // them on its first view. Image localisation runs here too; where a download // does not complete the item keeps its remote image URL and still renders. $plugin->items($feed->slug); $content = implode("\n", [ '

Latest from the roastery

', '

The six most recent posts from the roastery’s feed, rendered on the server through the plugin’s own templates: no iframe, no script, real markup in the page. Every card below is the Feed block in its grid layout.

', sprintf('', $feed->id), '

The same feed as a list

', '

One feed, another layout: the block picks the layout, the plugin’s layout-list.php renders it, and a theme can override either file. The feed itself is set up once under Feeds in wp-admin.

', sprintf('', $feed->id), ]); $page_id = wp_insert_post([ 'post_type' => 'page', 'post_title' => 'News', 'post_name' => 'news', 'post_status' => 'publish', 'post_content' => $content, ], true); // Land on the feed, not on the blog index: the page is the front page. if (!is_wp_error($page_id)) { update_option('show_on_front', 'page'); update_option('page_on_front', (int) $page_id); }

progress.caption: Seeding a feed and a page to show it on
